evidence_for: Published annual-parallax microlensing analysis and lens-light constraints motivate follow-up beyond duration.
evidence_against_or_unresolved: Stellar and remnant priors retain different near/far and lower-mass alternatives.
Gaia source astrometry has elevated RUWE; source distance and proper-motion assumptions matter.
Published Gaia errors were estimated; photometric errors were rescaled and a blend prior was used.
Independent adequate native-data recovery and direct angular-scale constraints are not established by this release.

bhsm_interpretation: Supported gravitational geometry is interpreted as BHSM surface topography, with one Einstein/GHY exterior optical response counted once. Target selection adds no force, mass or microscopic core measurement.
